title: Drow-ghosts
content:
See also [[drow]] and [[ghosts]].

The [[Princess of the Seers]] (in [[Winds]]) communicates with drow-ghosts.

The skull of [[The Defiler]] ([[City of Smoke]]) may have been lost to the drowned drow-ghosts.
